Privacy policy

Draft, attorney review required. This page is a placeholder and is not in effect.

Truscale respects your privacy. This draft outlines the topics the final policy will cover.

What we collect

  • Information you send in the beta application or contact form: name, company, role, city, email, optional phone, project volume and what you want to use first.
  • Project data you put into the app during the beta.

How we use it

  • To review beta applications and contact you about the beta.
  • To run and improve the product.

What we do not do

  • We never share or sell your information.

Free tools

The free calculators run in your browser. What you type in them is not sent to us.

Still to be written

  • Service providers, data retention, security, your rights, Texas and other state requirements, children, changes to this policy, contact details.
